views.front: The compact cooker now has a smooth round body and fitted lid, with the small front display retained.
views.rear: The back is a continuous closed appliance shell with aligned lid and lower trim, improving the original faceted cylinder.
views.detail: The pressure vent sits on the lid and the fine grip marks wrap the top knob correctly; neither detail floats above the surface.
views.underside: A closed dark base and continuous lower rim are visible, with the display attached to the body.
views.clay: The clay view confirms rounded manufactured body and lid contours with separate vent and knob construction.
